title: Testing Panics
goal: Verify that invalid function calls cause a panic as expected.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Afternoon: Unit Tests

hints: A function needs an attribute to mark it as a test, plus an attribute specifying it must panic.
Call the function with arguments that trigger the exact panic message.
explanation: `#[should_panic(expected = "...")]` asserts that running the test causes a panic containing the expected text. Plain `#[test]` without `#[should_panic]` fails the test run when `divide(10, 0)` panics. Specifying an expected string like `"invalid input"` fails when the actual panic message is `"divide by zero"`.
